evidence: The paper does not report impurity-based variable importance. Instead, it "calculated and visualized partial dependence functions capturing relationships between the average patient-specific probability of in-hospital death and hospital case volume." The entire analysis derives conclusions from partial dependence plots (PDP), which show nonlinear relationships without ranking features by importance. Features include mixed types: continuous (age, case volume), categorical (location, ownership, admission reason), and binary (sex, ICU admission).
